_schema: Locked 2026-05-21. Format descriptions are intentionally neutral — no scores hinted, no paper context.

formats.name: video
formats.description: Short video clips (5-60 seconds) distributed primarily on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels. Covers both fully AI-generated video (e.g., from Sora, Runway, Veo) and partially-modified video (deepfakes, face-swap, AI dubbing).

formats.name: audio
formats.description: Spoken audio: podcast episodes, voicemail, voice messages, narration for video, AI voice cloning of real people. Distributed on Spotify, podcast apps, messaging platforms.

formats.name: image
formats.description: Standalone still images: photos, illustrations, generated artwork, profile pictures, stock-photo replacements. Distributed across all social platforms and embedded in web content.

formats.name: text
formats.description: Prose text without embedded multimedia: blog posts, SEO articles, long-form content, newsletters. The unit of consumption is a paragraph or page of human language.

formats.name: hybrid_card_news
formats.description: Image-text hybrid carousels: multi-panel image posts with overlaid or adjacent short text (3-5 lines per panel). Standard format on Instagram carousels, Korean Naver and KakaoTalk 'card news', infographics.

formats.name: fake_reviews
formats.description: Short evaluative text reviews of products, services, restaurants, books — 1 to 5 stars plus a paragraph. Found on Amazon, Coupang, Google Reviews, Yelp, app stores.

formats.name: academic_papers
formats.description: Scholarly publications: research papers, conference proceedings, abstracts, scientific manuscripts. Distributed via arXiv, journal websites, preprint servers, and institutional repositories.

formats.name: news_articles
formats.description: News reporting and journalistic articles in mainstream outlets, partisan blogs, and content farms. Long-form text with attributed authorship, embedded in news websites and RSS feeds.
